digest.component_or_area: shared git seam (gitutil) and event store writes
propositions: run_git_write lacks retry coverage for write-side temp-file creation faults (ENOENT/EINVAL/database-insert markers) despite event_append.git_add already retrying the same faults on its own code path
s3_doctor.git_commit_tree and other non-event_append callers of run_git_write abort on transient runner-FS faults that would self-heal if routed through event_append
moving the write-side marker family from event_append into the shared gitutil seam ensures exactly one definition and uniform retry coverage for all run_git_write callers
the nested 3x3 retry composition on commit paths is collapsed to the intended bounded 3-attempt budget, matching read-side fault retry
corrupt-object signatures remain excluded from retry (loose object is corrupt, inflate data stream error) so genuinely persistent faults fail loudly
